Before you choose.

Do I need to book consultancy first?+

No. QR menus and screen content can be commissioned as a standalone digital project. If costs, menu decisions or service need attention, the audit is still available.

What does it cost and how long does it take?+

It depends on the menu, languages, visuals and equipment. You receive the price and schedule in writing before commissioning. Any recurring cost is identified in the proposal.

Will it work on my existing TV?+

We confirm the equipment and display method before agreeing the scope. Visual content does not automatically include hardware, channel broadcasting, live data or POS integration.

How do I know whether it helps sales?+

Choose a comparison period and track orders for featured products, average order value and margin. Digital content adds visibility; results also depend on your offer, footfall and service. We do not promise a revenue increase.
